- `merger_acquisition_doc_example.json` is the first documented `Response (200 OK)` JSON body from https://docs.benzinga.com/api-reference/calendar-api/get-ma.
- `offering_doc_example.json` is the first documented `Response (200 OK)` JSON body from https://docs.benzinga.com/api-reference/calendar-api/get-offerings.

- `ipo_doc_example.json` is the first documented `Response (200 OK)` JSON body from https://docs.benzinga.com/api-reference/calendar-api/get-ipos.
- `option_activity_doc_example.json` is the first documented `Response (200 OK)` JSON body from https://docs.benzinga.com/api-reference/calendar-api/get-optionactivity.
- `insider_trade_doc_example.json` is the first documented `Response (200 OK)` JSON body from https://docs.benzinga.com/api-reference/calendar-api/insider-transaction/get-insider-transaction-filing.
- `congress_trade_doc_example.json` is the first documented `Response (200 OK)` JSON body from https://docs.benzinga.com/api-reference/calendar-api/government-trades/get-government-trades.

- `ipo_schema_doc_example.json` combines the documented IPO response fields with the OpenAPI schema examples for `date`, `deal_status`, and `price_public_offering`; it is a schema example, not a captured provider response.
